title: A refused final-check read says what the plugin's words mean, and card links sharing one address are no contract gap
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A refused read keeps a fixed code of the plugin's words and the contract key or column they name, never the words; a hidden card link whose address several rows' slots share stays as the template prints it, a skipped line, never a contract-has-no-slot block.

tests: a refused read keeps its action, operation and the plugin code, never the message
a refused read keeps what the plugin's words say as a code and the contract key they name, never the words
a card link whose address several rows' slots share, hidden alone, stays as the template prints it
